title: Pipe clipboard content to a command in Wayland
summary: Use wl-paste with a pipe to send the current clipboard content as input to another command. This allows you to process copied text directly in the terminal.

aliases.text: передать буфер обмена в команду wayland

steps.explain: Run wl-paste and pipe its output to another command using the vertical bar.

placeholders.description: The command you want to receive the clipboard content as input.

steps.expect: The specified command processes the clipboard text and outputs its result.
